correction.withdrawn_notation: The frozen interface names the pure zero-external-flow projection P0. That notation conflicts with the governing whole spectral-ground P0 convention and must not be used by the linked consumer.
correction.P_flow0: P_flow0 = product_external_raw_e (I-F_e), F_e=1_(k_e!=0). This is the ENTIRE zero-external-flow superselection block, containing arbitrary neutral local excitations; it is not the ground projector.
correction.Pi_ground: Pi_ground = P_ground = P0 = product_v P_v = |Omega_g><Omega_g|, where P_v=S_v G_v, S_v=1_(w_v=0), G_v=|g><g| extended by zero on other local total-number sectors, and Omega_g is the exact reference product g with its Gauss-bound internal electric degrees. This rank-one spectral projector identity is conditional on the same accepted frozen-law ground premises as the additive form.
correction.Q_ground: Q_ground = I-Pi_ground. Every neutral zero-external-flow excitation orthogonal to Omega_g remains in Q_ground. Q_ground is never replaced by I-P_flow0, a rho projector, a source-image complement, or a mean-density complement.
correction.Q_flow: Q_flow = I-P_flow0 is ONLY the nonzero-external-flow subspace and is a proper subprojection of Q_ground.
correction.exact_decomposition: Pi_ground <= P_flow0; Q_ground = (I-P_flow0) + (P_flow0-Pi_ground) = Q_flow + P_flow0 Q_ground. The summands are orthogonal commuting projections. P_flow0-Pi_ground is the neutral zero-flow excited subspace and MUST remain in ground-complement resolvents and time integrals.
correction.defect_definition_unchanged: Delta_v=I-P_v and D_defect=sum_v Delta_v are unchanged. All these projectors strongly commute with H0. ker(D_defect)=range(Pi_ground); consequently D_defect>=Q_ground. On P_flow0, D_defect is the sum of exact local g-complement projectors, not zero.
correction.form_unchanged: L=H0-(N^3/2)E_g >= gamma D_defect with gamma=46955312929/34359738368, together with the previously derived simultaneous and excess-flow forms. The proof and occupation/affine coverage do not depend on the erroneous name P0 for P_flow0.
correction.heat_domain: The defect-pattern projector with zero defects is precisely Pi_ground. The sum of positive-defect pattern projectors is Q_ground, including zero-flow neutral patterns. Thus ||exp(-tL)Q_ground||<=exp(-gamma t), and each pattern with d>=1 defects has bound exp(-gamma t d). A ground-complement inverse is Q_ground L^{-1} Q_ground; restricting instead to Q_flow would wrongly delete paid neutral zero-flow intervals. No allorder linked radius is claimed by these identities.

exact_domain_witness.meaning: This exact current-reference domain witness distinguishes the two projectors and shows why neutral zero-flow excitations cannot be omitted. It is a derived operator witness, not a new numerical experiment or a full-H negative counterexample.
